Record Clearing Implementation Authority Reconciled (2026-08-24), sheet: Completed Decision Matrix - controls the other 49 decisions
Record Clearing Implementation Authority Reconciled (2026-08-24), sheet: Mississippi Override Register - controls the thirteen Mississippi route categories

decisions.outputMode: COURT PETITION PACKET + CONTESTED-NEXUS REFERRAL
decisions.effectiveDateNote: No operational delay identified; do not reuse general Alabama waiting tables.

decisions.outputMode: AUTOMATIC STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE OR COURT PETITION PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Automatic and petition categories must never share a checkout path.

decisions.outputMode: AUTOMATIC STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE OR JUVENILE COURT PETITION PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: The 120-day Attorney General response period must be modeled only as post-filing procedure.

decisions.outputMode: MIXED - AGENCY APPLICATION, COURT PACKET, OR AUTOMATIC STATUS GUIDANCE
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Do not treat FDLE or prosecutor processing deadlines as prefiling waits.

decisions.outputMode: MIXED - STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE OR COURT PETITION PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: The first-offender intake must explicitly branch on the July 1, 2026 statutory change.

decisions.outputMode: COURT/AGENCY APPLICATION PACKET BY ROUTE
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Model the July 1, 2025 one-step Attorney General procedure; do not treat agency processing time as a wait.

decisions.outputMode: AUTOMATIC STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE, CLEMENCY REFERRAL, OR LIMITED PETITION PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: A pardon application is not a routine court-expungement packet and must be labeled accordingly.

decisions.outputMode: COURT CORRECTION PETITION OR PROSTITUTION VACATUR/EXPUNGEMENT PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Do not route identity correction through the ordinary expungement eligibility engine.

decisions.outputMode: COURT PETITION PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Positive and negative tests must prove the ordinary three-year rule is bypassed only for the qualifying specialty-court branch.

decisions.outputMode: AUTOMATIC STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE OR JUVENILE COURT PETITION PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Do not present the two-year period to a user in the automatic dismissal/not-delinquent branch.

decisions.outputMode: COURT EXPUNGEMENT PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Do not attach the five-year alternative route or DWI-diversion arrest-date clock unless independently applicable.

decisions.outputMode: COURT EXPUNGEMENT PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: The product must verify the pardon rather than infer it solely from a completion date.

decisions.outputMode: COURT EXPUNGEMENT PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Do not reuse Article 978's alternative clean-period routes as a mandatory wait for an 893(E) dismissal.

decisions.outputMode: MIXED - STATUS REQUEST, DERIVATIVE PACKET, CERTIFIED SURVIVOR PACKET, PROGRAM PACKET, OR INTERIM PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Article 985.2 must remain operationally gated if statutory funding or agency functionality is unavailable.

decisions.outputMode: AUTOMATIC STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE OR COURT SEALING/EXPUNGEMENT PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Never apply § 100A's conviction-sealing waits to § 100C nonconvictions or the special marijuana route.

decisions.outputMode: AGENCY REQUEST OR AUTOMATIC STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Do not display the 60-day agency processing period as a participant wait.

decisions.outputMode: AUTOMATIC STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE OR JUVENILE PETITION PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: The statutory court-processing period for the automatic branch is not a prefiling wait.

decisions.outputMode: COURT SET-ASIDE PACKET + NONCOVERED-OFFENSE REFERRAL
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Do not broaden this route based on pending 2025-2026 legislation that has not become law.

decisions.outputMode: MIXED - AGENCY DEMAND, AUTOMATIC STATUS GUIDANCE, BOARD REVIEW, AGREED-SEALING, OR COURT PETITION
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Explicitly label the ten-year § 299C.11 condition as a prior-conviction lookback, not a clock from arrest.

decisions.outputMode: COURT PETITION PACKET BY STATUTE
decisions.effectiveDateNote: The age-21 clock and the § 610.140 completion clock must be separate rule objects.

decisions.outputMode: AUTOMATIC STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE OR INCARCERATED-PERSON COURT PETITION
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Do not sell a routine § 610.140 packet for a constitutionally automatic marijuana record.

decisions.outputMode: STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE OR SPECIAL COURT PETITION
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Do not activate the new August 28, 2026 automatic provision before its effective date.

decisions.outputMode: THIRTEEN ROUTE-SPECIFIC PACKET / GUIDANCE / REFERRAL / AUTOMATIC OUTCOMES
decisions.effectiveDateNote: The Mississippi Definitive Route Decisions report supersedes the general 50-row report and the original LD-MS-01 row wherever they conflict. Controlling corrections: 3-year felony rule effective 2026-07-01; no consumer packet for DUI nonadjudication; automatic intervention-court branch; general nonconviction relief at § 99-19-71(4).

decisions.outputMode: STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE OR LIMITED COURT/AGENCY PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Do not add a general expungement clock after the deferred sentence terminates.

decisions.outputMode: AGENCY CORRECTION REQUEST OR COURT MARIJUANA PETITION
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Do not send a record-correction user through the marijuana or general set-aside engine.

decisions.outputMode: AUTOMATIC STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE OR AGENCY REQUEST
decisions.effectiveDateNote: The statutory court-to-CRISS reporting period is processing, not an applicant wait.

decisions.outputMode: COURT EXPUNCTION PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Do not borrow the waiting periods in §§ 15A-145 or 15A-145.5.

decisions.outputMode: ERROR PETITION OR SET-ASIDE APPLICATION
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Results copy must say that a set-aside does not erase the Nebraska record.

decisions.outputMode: AUTOMATIC STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE OR ANNULMENT PETITION
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Require the actual vacatur order; a claimed appeal or collateral challenge is not enough.

decisions.outputMode: AUTOMATIC STATUS GUIDANCE OR ROUTE-SPECIFIC COURT EXPUNGEMENT PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Do not implement pending 2026 bills as enacted law; use current five- and ten-year statutes as of August 24, 2026.

decisions.outputMode: AGENCY DNA EXPUNGEMENT REQUEST
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Agency 30- or 45-day processing periods must not be shown as prefiling waits.

decisions.outputMode: COURT SEALING PACKET OR TRAFFICKING VACATUR/SEALING PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Do not transplant NRS 176A.245/.265/.295 timing into NRS 176.211.

decisions.outputMode: ELEVEN ROUTE-SPECIFIC OUTPUTS - MANUAL PETITION, AUTOMATIC STATUS, SPECIAL PETITION, OR GUIDANCE
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Launch-critical: portal due November 1, 2026; automated identification due November 1, 2027; electronic backlog due November 1, 2029. Do not represent those systems as live before verified deployment.

decisions.outputMode: COURT SET-ASIDE PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: The prior dismissed-branch hold is resolved by the current text: ordinary dismissal is any time after dismissal; the 60-day branch is limited to no accusatory instrument.

decisions.outputMode: SPECIAL MARIJUANA MOTION OR GENERAL SET-ASIDE PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Offense class and date are mandatory intake facts for the fallback general route.

decisions.outputMode: ROUTE-SPECIFIC COURT EXPUNGEMENT OR VACATUR PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: ARD completion and dismissal are distinct facts and should both be captured.

decisions.outputMode: AUTOMATIC STATUS/CORRECTION, ADMINISTRATIVE REQUEST, OR COURT MOTION
decisions.effectiveDateNote: All four numerical periods must be labeled as processing/notice periods except the separate domestic-violence retention condition.

decisions.outputMode: STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE OR LIMITED COURT APPLICATION
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Do not convert the court-set filing term into a generic fixed waitingPeriodRule.

decisions.outputMode: OFFENSE-SPECIFIC PACKET, NONCONVICTION/JUVENILE PACKET, OR PARDON GUIDANCE ONLY
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Results copy must affirmatively disclose that a pardon does not erase or seal the South Carolina conviction.

decisions.outputMode: AUTOMATIC/AGENCY SEALING STATUS GUIDANCE OR CORRECTION REQUEST
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Out-of-chapter or out-of-state pardons require referral rather than automatic eligibility.

decisions.outputMode: JUVENILE TRAFFICKING PETITION OR SIS STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Do not preserve the prior blanket attorney-referral treatment for an otherwise complete § 26-7A-115.1 intake.

decisions.outputMode: EX PARTE EXPUNCTION PETITION OR ORDER/STATUS GUIDANCE
decisions.effectiveDateNote: The thirty-day court deadline and hearing notice period are procedural and must not be stored as eligibility waits.

decisions.outputMode: AUTOMATIC STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE OR PETITION PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Generic offense_level is insufficient; the flow must collect Utah Class A/B/C/infraction and the precise statutory category.

decisions.outputMode: AUTOMATIC STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE OR TRAFFIC PETITION PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: A single 'traffic' answer cannot calculate eligibility; class is a mandatory rendered fact.

decisions.outputMode: SPECIAL COURT PETITION, PARDON STATUS GUIDANCE, OR JUVENILE PETITION
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Remove the current contradictory guidance-only treatment from any special route that expressly authorizes a participant-filed petition.

decisions.outputMode: AUTOMATIC STATUS/CORRECTION GUIDANCE OR JUVENILE SEALING MOTION
decisions.effectiveDateNote: A diversion and an adjudication must not share a generic juvenile waiting value without the exact branch facts.

decisions.outputMode: SPECIAL CONVICTION-VACATION PACKET BY ROUTE
decisions.effectiveDateNote: The ordinary RCW 9.96.060 three-year rule must be bypassed only for the express cannabis subsection.

decisions.outputMode: COURT EXPUNGEMENT PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: The six-month duration must be added to the jurisdiction's structured waitingPeriodRules with the statutory source text.

decisions.outputMode: COURT VACATUR/EXPUNGEMENT PACKET + NONCOVERED-OFFENSE REFERRAL
decisions.effectiveDateNote: Do not label the route as covering every trafficking-related West Virginia conviction.

decisions.outputMode: COURT VACATUR PETITION PACKET
decisions.effectiveDateNote: The intake should permit alternative nexus evidence and not require a single certification form if the statute does not.

decisions.outputMode: AUTOMATIC CLOSURE GUIDANCE + CLERK AND ORIGINAL-CASE CORRECTION
decisions.effectiveDateNote: The amendment governs dispositions entered on or after 2025-08-01. A disposition before that date takes the official petition and proposed order instead, which is a service branch on this route and is not built.

decisions.outputMode: SOLICITOR-ADMINISTERED PROCESS GUIDANCE + RETAINED-COUNSEL HANDOFF ON DENIAL
decisions.effectiveDateNote: No operational delay. The rescinded $150 administrative figure must not appear; the controlling figure is $250. The fee schedule belongs to this route alone and must not be copied onto the other seven South Carolina routes.
